title: New Curriculum, New Chance – Retrieval Augmented Generation for Lesson Planning in Ugandan Secondary Schools. Prototype Quality Evaluation.
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the technical quality of lesson plans generated by an LLM-based RAG system using the Lesson Plan Analysis Protocol (LPAP). While it briefly mentions 'ethical considerations' in the discussion section as an area for future research, it does not formally evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
